title: Han Solo
description: Princess Leia tries to comfort a grieving Luke after they escape from the Death Star, but immediate concerns snap him back into action. TIE fighters of the Empire close in on the Millennium Falcon, sparking an intense space battle. Experienced Captain Han Solo manages to blow attacking craft out of the starry sky, and he finds himself ably assisted by young Luke, who does the same. Out of harm's way, at least for the moment, the Falcon crew speeds toward Yavin 4 with R2-D2's invaluable readouts of the Death Star... unaware that Darth Vader is tracking their ship...
